Chapter 684: Chapter 15: Breakthrough Preparation (Subscription Request)_3

Chapter 684: Chapter 15: Breakthrough Preparation (Subscription Request)_3

The martial path that shuttled between worlds was merely a crude application of the physical body’s vitality, and its upper limit barely reached the First Rank.

And the Martial Path Evolutionary Path? It even aspired to become the Supreme Evolution Path.

“Just update it directly,” Lin Yuan, having sorted out the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, reselected to upload, replacing the original Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

…..

Virtual World of the Southern Star Region.

Central Plaza Area.

...

Countless Evolvers and high-ranking citizens were casually chatting.

At that moment—

“Look, the evolution rankings have been updated.”

“Martial Path Evolutionary Path has risen to forty-second place.”

“That’s terrifying, a Ninth Rank Evolution Path breaking into the forty-second place of the star region rankings?”

“The founder behind the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is definitely one of the top evolutionary scholars of our human civilization, having reached unimaginable realms in the field of evolution.”

“Judging by the current ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, when he uploads the Tenth Rank Chapter and it becomes a Tenth Rank Evolution Path, wouldn’t it be able to directly enter the top ten of the evolution rankings?”

…

Many Evolvers and high-ranking citizens were discussing fervently; by now, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had become the most legendary evolution path in the Southern Star Region.

Its influence was even greater than those of the top ten evolution paths in the star region ranking, all of which were at the Eleventh Rank Peak.

Evolution paths at the Eleventh Rank Peak generally had histories of one or two hundred million years and had reached the end of their potential.

But the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was only at Ninth Rank; if it reached Tenth Rank or even Eleventh Rank, what position would it rank on the evolution leaderboard?

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan glanced at the latest rankings of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“It has risen eleven places.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

This time he updated the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, merely making minor adjustments, and the entire Martial Path Evolutionary Path had moved up from fifty-third to forty-second place.

It completely met Lin Yuan’s expectations.

The rise in the rankings of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path also earned Lin Yuan a reward of eight million Merit Points.

This was also the result jointly determined by the three goddesses. Although the updated Martial Path Evolutionary Path did not have any significant increase in potential, its adaptability had broadened, and each rank nearly reached perfection.

“These decades of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path have developed quite well…”

Lin Yuan pulled up the latest training data of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, including the number of Evolvers at each stage.

“First Tier Chapter: Eight trillion.”

“Second Layer Chapter: Nine thousand two hundred billion.”

“Third Rank Chapter: Nine billion.”

“Fourth Rank Chapter: Eighty million.”

“Fifth Stage Section: Twelve million.”

“Sixth Rank Chapter: One million and thirty thousand.”

“Seventh Rank Chapter: Five thousand six.”

“Eighth Layer Part: Zero.”

…

“The number of Evolvers from the First Tier Chapter to the Third Rank Chapter has exploded by dozens of times, but from the Fourth Rank Chapter onwards, the growth rate has been much less.”

Lin Yuan was not surprised.

No matter the evolutionary path, in the early stages of cultivation—from the First Tier Chapter to the Third Rank Chapter—it could be “quickly completed.”

Before involving the comprehension of the essence of laws, evolution was nothing more than an accumulation of energy.

And energy accumulation, as long as there are enough resources, is not an issue.

But starting from the Fourth Stage Martial Tao, comprehension of the laws begins.

This aspect cannot be “quickly completed”; at most, external forces make the comprehension somewhat easier.

But definitely, it cannot happen without comprehension directly into improvement.

Compared to decades, the number of Martial Arts Evolutionaries in the Sixth Rank Chapter and the Seventh Rank Chapter has hardly changed.

“These years, I’ve probably accumulated over ten million Cubic Universe Crystals…” Lin Yuan glanced over the revenue share from the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Ten million Cubic Universe Crystals, even significant for a Tenth Rank Evolver, is not a small amount.

They are even the complete fortune of a normal Ninth Rank of Myriad Heavy Realm.

But these are just what the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has accumulated over the recent thirty years.

Thirty years is extraordinarily brief, not just for Ninth Rank or Tenth Rank Evolvers, but even for Eighth Rank Evolvers.

…

Milky Way Star Region.

Xia Qin Supreme Being stood quietly, with all the Milky Way Star Region and the surrounding many star regions and even the Star Alliance entirely within the sight of this Supreme Being.

Even as merely an incarnation, he possessed the foundational combat power of a Twelfth Stage Powerhouse, let alone, with the incarnation as “Guiding Mark,” Xia Qin Supreme Being’s real body could arrive in an instant.

“Being able to thoroughly understand the Rule of Time at Ninth Rank is incredible…” Beside, the form of the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being emerged, condensed from phantom forces.

Among the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being’s combat power wasn’t considered strong, but was still indispensable. The virtual world network covering the entirety of human civilization originated from Feather Butterfly Supreme Being.

The so-called virtual world that replicates nearly 100% of reality is an exquisite dream crafted by Feather Butterfly Supreme Being.

In collaboration with the human civilization’s Clan Suppression Weapon—Void Realm World.

That made the virtual world possess nearly ninety percent of the essential operations of the Main Universe.

With the virtual world, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being could arrive at any location within the human territory in an instant.

“That’s right,” Xia Qin Supreme Being replied quite contentedly.

Making a Supreme Being utter ‘incredible’ is definitely a rarity to the extreme.

As a Supreme Being of the phantom dreams domain, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being’s vision was far superior to ordinary Supreme Beings. Her ‘incredible’ carried a value that could astonish her peers at the same level.

“When the Galaxy Master breaks through, it will trigger the infusion of Chaos Void Origin, at which time we will need to join hands to block temporal perception,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said.

The so-called blocking of temporal perception is essentially hiding the specific location of the Main Universe where the infusion of the Chaos Void Origin happens.

Other different species’ Supreme Beings might sense something but would only know that an Evolver within the Human Civilization Territory is undergoing the infusion of Chaos Void Origin.

As for the exact location, it would become untraceable.

Blocking temporal perception is also a frequently used method by Supreme Beings.

The intent is to confuse the eyes of other different species’ Supreme Beings.

“No problem,” Feather Butterfly Supreme Being nodded.

In fact, Xia Qin Supreme Being alone could accomplish the blocking of space and time.

But to be cautious, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being was also called upon.
